package.name: robotar_description
package.description: Original Xacro/URDF description of the robotar olive-harvesting field platform: a rugged four-wheel differential-drive rover with a 6-DOF side-mounted field arm, a mast RGB-D camera, a chassis IMU and launch-selectable comb/gripper tools behind a common tool0 flange. All geometry, joint names/limits and interface names are sourced from config/physical.yaml (single source of truth).
